To tackle these challenges, many approaches employ voxelization or custom discretization for point clouds.

solution.summary: In this paper, we leverage the high-quality region proposal network and a Channel-wise Transformer architecture to constitute our two-stage 3D object detection framework (CT3D) with minimal hand-crafted design. In this paper, we make two major contributions.
solution.approach: In this paper, we leverage the high-quality region proposal network and a Channel-wise Transformer architecture to constitute our two-stage 3D object detection framework (CT3D) with minimal hand-crafted design.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we leverage the high-quality region proposal network and a Channel-wise Transformer architecture to constitute our two-stage 3D object detection framework (CT3D) with minimal hand-crafted design.
In this paper, we make two major contributions.
First, we propose a novel end-to-end two-stage 3D objection detection framework called CT3D.

experiments.summary: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our CT3D method has superior performance and excellent scalability. Remarkably, CT3D achieves the AP of 81.77% in the moderate car category on the KITTI test 3D detection benchmark, outperforms state-of-the-art 3D detectors.

evidence.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our CT3D method has superior performance and excellent scalability.
Remarkably, CT3D achieves the AP of 81.77% in the moderate car category on the KITTI test 3D detection benchmark, outperforms state-of-the-art 3D detectors.
